description: Search open remote jobs on Remotejobify by where the person lives. Each job comes with who can apply, the line from the listing that proves it, pay when listed, and a link. Pass country whenever you know where they live: most remote jobs are only open to some countries. Without it you get jobs open worldwide.

country.description: The country the person lives in: a name ("Philippines", "UK") or a two-letter code ("PH", "GB").

limit.description: How many jobs, up to 20. 10 if not given.

query.description: Words for the job title or company, like "customer support", "python" or "nurse". Optional.

role.description: A job type, to narrow the search. Optional.

working_hours.description: daytime: the job keeps business hours that are daytime where they live. night_shift: night there (only jobs whose listing states its hours). part_time: part-time jobs. daytime and night_shift need country.

name: search_jobs
title: Search remote jobs
